QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-confirmed dive-the-world.com, starfish.ch, scubajunkiesangalaki.com, maratua.com, asiadivingvacation.com. Two unverifiable overly-precise statistics could NOT be re-confirmed against any source on this pass and were REMOVED from markdown as likely hallucinated: (1) 'Manta Parade accounts for 42.9% of recorded cleaning behaviour at Sangalaki' -- no scubajunkiesangalaki.com page or any other source states this figure; (2) 'Up to 20 mantas have been recorded ... during peak full-moon feeding events' -- targeted search for this claim returned no Sangalaki-specific source (only unrelated Hanifaru Bay/Maldives data). Replaced with general, source-backed description of manta aggregation behaviour. This is a correction of a likely hallucination introduced in the 2026-06-27 pass despite the source list looking adequate -- source list breadth did not guarantee every sentence was traceable.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched asiadivesite.com and padi.com directly. PADI confirms 25m depth, Advanced recommendation, chevron barracuda/jackfish/sharks/eagle rays. Asia Dive Site confirms drift dive around wall point, chevron barracuda + big-eye trevally schools; that fetch did not itself mention the grab line or hammerhead sharks, but both are independently corroborated by indonesia.greatestdivesites.com and maratua.com/kakaban (grab line permanently secured at 24m on upcurrent flat area; occasional hammerhead sightings, best shark site in area with leopard/grey reef/occasional hammerhead). Hammerhead claim remains appropriately caveated as periodic/conditions-dependent. All facts hold.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched wannadive.net and asiadivesite.com directly, plus independent search. Chimney/cavern depths (2m entrance, 21m to cavern, 30m cavern bottom, 44m primary exit, ~64m technical exit, ~250m external wall) confirmed by asiadivesite.com and a third independent source (matching maratua-area cave description). 120m horizontal cavern swim independently confirmed via search. Note: wannadive.net states exits at '45 and 65 meters' (vs. 44/64m elsewhere) -- a 1m rounding discrepancy between sources; 44/64m retained as the figure corroborated by two independent sources. All other facts hold.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched scubajunkiesangalaki.com jellyfish lake page directly -- confirmed four species, sizes, 11,000+ year lake age, 5 hectare area, 17m max depth, snorkel-only rule, no-fins/no-sunscreen/no-touch rules, ~45 min visit duration. All facts hold, no changes required.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched scubajunkiesangalaki.com/diving-maratua/ and padi.com directly, plus independent search. IMPORTANT depth conflict identified: PADI's Big Fish Country page states maximum depth '65 feet / 20 meters', while Scuba Junkie Sangalaki explicitly calls it 'a deep dive (30m)' and ZuBlu describes divers stationing at the channel entrance at 27m and the junction at ~30m. Markdown updated to note this discrepancy explicitly rather than silently picking one figure; JSON depth retained at 30m as the figure supported by two independent sources (Scuba Junkie, ZuBlu) against PADI's single lower figure. Scuba Junkie's refusal to guide this site and 3hr+ evacuation time re-confirmed verbatim. All other facts hold.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched padi.com directly -- confirmed 15m max depth and the 'if you can count the turtles...it is not a normal dive' quote verbatim. Note: PADI's page geotags this site as 'Togian Islands, Central Sulawesi', which is inconsistent with the listed coordinates (2.19994, 118.59286, which fall in the Derawan Archipelago near Maratua, not Togian which is ~1300km away near Sulawesi) -- this is judged to be an error in PADI's own location database, since all site-specific content (depth, turtle behaviour, proximity to Green Nirvana Maratua Resort) matches Derawan/Maratua exactly. Retained our existing Maratua/Derawan location attribution; did not import PADI's Togian mislabel. All other facts hold.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched sienna-resort.com and scubajunkiesangalaki.com/top-dive-sites-in-the-derawan/ directly. Confirmed 23m practical depth / 30m sandy plateau, bumphead parrotfish, napoleon wrasse, white-tip/grey reef sharks, gorgonian fans. Note: Sienna Resort calls the site 'excellent for all levels' while Scuba Junkie's top-sites page frames it for 'current lovers' -- these are not strictly contradictory (mild-to-moderate variable conditions) and support the existing Intermediate rating as a reasonable middle ground. All facts hold, no changes required.

QA 2026-08-28: Re-audited. Re-fetched padi.com directly (28m/91ft confirmed, thresher cleaning at dawn confirmed, 18m accessible to Open Water divers confirmed). Re-searched ISRA thresher cleaning station depth claim: confirmed 30-38m cleaning station depth via search of sharkrayareas.org content, though a direct fetch of the ISRA portfolio page itself did not name 'Kelapa Dua' specifically (it discusses Maratua/Kakaban cleaning stations generally) -- the site-specific 30-38m figure is corroborated by the PADI-derived aggregator text returned in search, not by directly reading the word 'Kelapa Dua' on the ISRA page itself. Retained the claim as PADI + the secondary aggregator agree, but this is a slightly softer sourcing chain than the original note implied. All other facts hold.
